title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #2

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The two surahs of seeking refuge are (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad and An-Nasr
   B. Al-Kafirun and Al-Fatiha
   C. Al-Fatiha and Al-Ikhlas
   D. Al-Falaq and An-Naas

2. Which of these is a trait of the Prophet's character? (1 mark)
   A. Honesty
   B. Laziness
   C. Boasting
   D. Cheating

3. What does "Al-Amin" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The strong
   B. The tall
   C. The rich
   D. The trustworthy

4. Who narrated the eating hadith from the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Bukhari
   B. Al-Hakim
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Ibn Majah

5. How should we treat a guest at the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Serve them first and respect them
   B. Ignore them
   C. Eat quickly before them
   D. Give them the smallest share

6. What should we say before brushing? (1 mark)
   A. Amin only
   B. Goodbye
   C. Nothing
   D. Bismillah

7. What is fair play? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping the rules and not cheating
   B. Winning at all costs
   C. Insulting opponents
   D. Ignoring the referee

8. Which of these is an Islamic etiquette in sport? (1 mark)
   A. Bad words
   B. No insults or fighting
   C. Skipping prayer
   D. Betting

9. According to the hadith, how many names does Allah have that whoever learns and understands them is rewarded? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Ninety-nine
   C. Twelve
   D. Forty

10. What does "Al-Malik" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The King and Owner of everything
   B. The All-Seeing
   C. The Most Kind
   D. The Source of Peace

11. What does "Ar-Rahim" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Source of Peace
   B. The Most Merciful, with special mercy to believers
   C. The All-Hearing
   D. The Owner of the Day

12. Which angel takes the souls at death? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Raqib
   C. Mikail
   D. Malakul Maut

13. Which is a wrong belief about angels? (1 mark)
   A. That they are Allah's daughters
   B. That they obey Allah
   C. That they carry out duties
   D. That they are made of light

14. Who is the last prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Isa
   B. Sulaiman
   C. Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   D. Yahya

15. Who was the first prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Adam
   B. Ibrahim
   C. Nuh
   D. Musa

16. How many types of najasaat are taught in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Two
   C. Five
   D. Three

17. What does the Prophet say about wudhu on the Day of Judgement? (1 mark)
   A. Believers will have shining marks from wudhu
   B. Wudhu will be forgotten
   C. Only rich people will shine
   D. Nothing

18. Why is wudhu important? (1 mark)
   A. It is needed for the prayer to be valid
   B. It is a game
   C. It makes prayer shorter
   D. It replaces prayer

19. What is the meaning of niyyah? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer mat
   B. Intention in the heart
   C. Direction
   D. Prayer times

20. Which prayer has three rak'ahs? (1 mark)
   A. Maghrib
   B. Asr
   C. Fajr
   D. Isha

21. What is taslim? (1 mark)
   A. Dua
   B. The ending greeting of the prayer
   C. The beginning of prayer
   D. Bowing

22. What should you do before putting a load on a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore its health
   B. Add extra sacks
   C. Hit it
   D. Make sure it is not too heavy

23. What is the awrah? (1 mark)
   A. The parts of the body that must be covered
   B. A fast
   C. A cap
   D. A prayer

24. What is assertiveness in dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. Politely standing by how you dress because of faith
   C. Copying everyone
   D. Insulting others

25. Why should clothes not carry rude words or pictures? (1 mark)
   A. They are cheap
   B. They are heavy
   C. They disrespect faith and others
   D. They fade

26. Which is a negative use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Calling grandmother
   B. Listening to Qur'an
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Studying

27. Why is it bad when children are made to beg? (1 mark)
   A. It makes them strong
   B. They miss school and face danger
   C. They learn a lot
   D. It helps them study

28. Why do we say the dua for leaving home? (1 mark)
   A. To pass time
   B. To be fashionable
   C. To be loud
   D. To seek Allah's protection

29. What did the Prophet say when the angel told him to read? (1 mark)
   A. I am tired
   B. I cannot read
   C. I will read
   D. I am busy

30. To which town did the Prophet go to invite people to Islam about ten years after the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. Madinah
   B. Habasha
   C. Cairo
   D. Taif

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. What does it mean that children are an amanah? (2 marks)

32. Explain why Muslims do not worship angels. (3 marks)

33. State two reasons why a Muslim recites Al-Fatiha in every prayer. (2 marks)

34. Describe three good manners of eating apart from saying Bismillah. (3 marks)

35. Explain the message of the last verse of Surah Al-Kafirun. (3 marks)

36. What lesson do we learn from Surah Al-Masad? (3 marks)

37. State two lessons from Surah An-Nasr. (2 marks)

38. Suggest three honest ways of earning a living. (3 marks)

39. When must a child not obey a parent, and how should the child still behave? (3 marks)

40. Write any ten prophets mentioned in the Qur'an. (5 marks)

41. Explain the meaning of modesty in dressing. (3 marks)

42. Write the pillars of swalah from ruku up to taslim. (5 marks)

43. Name the three types of najasaat. (3 marks)

44. Role-play plan: Write a short scene showing a parent fulfilling one obligation and the child's thanks. (5 marks)

45. Describe what happened to Taif in later years. (3 marks)

46. What does twahara mean and why is it important? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Al-Falaq and An-Naas
   Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge".

2. A — Honesty
   The Prophet was known as trustworthy and truthful.

3. D — The trustworthy
   The people of Makkah called Muhammad Al-Amin.

4. A — Al-Bukhari
   The syllabus gives Al-Bukhari.

5. A — Serve them first and respect them
   Hospitality is a Muslim value.

6. D — Bismillah
   Bismillah is said before good acts.

7. A — Keeping the rules and not cheating
   Fair play means honesty in sport.

8. B — No insults or fighting
   A Muslim keeps good manners on the field.

9. B — Ninety-nine
   The hadith speaks of ninety-nine names.

10. A — The King and Owner of everything
   Al-Malik means the true King.

11. B — The Most Merciful, with special mercy to believers
   Ar-Rahim is Allah's special mercy.

12. D — Malakul Maut
   Malakul Maut is the Angel of Death, also called Izrail.

13. A — That they are Allah's daughters
   Islam rejects this.

14. C — Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   Qur'an 33:40 calls him Seal of the Prophets.

15. A — Adam
   Adam was the first human and prophet.

16. D — Three
   Light, medium and heavy.

17. A — Believers will have shining marks from wudhu
   Recorded by Muslim.

18. A — It is needed for the prayer to be valid
   Prayer is not accepted without it.

19. B — Intention in the heart
   Niyyah is intention.

20. A — Maghrib
   Maghrib has three.

21. B — The ending greeting of the prayer
   As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatullah.

22. D — Make sure it is not too heavy
   Do not overload an animal.

23. A — The parts of the body that must be covered
   Awrah is what must be covered.

24. B — Politely standing by how you dress because of faith
   You calmly explain.

25. C — They disrespect faith and others
   Clothes should be modest.

26. C — Spreading rumours
   Rumours can hurt.

27. B — They miss school and face danger
   Children should be protected.

28. D — To seek Allah's protection
   We ask for protection.

29. B — I cannot read
   He was unlettered.

30. D — Taif
   He went to Taif.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: A trust from Allah that parents must look after.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for trust and 1 mark for parents' care.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Angels are servants of Allah created to obey Him. Worship belongs to Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for servants of Allah, 1 mark for obey, 1 mark for worship only to Allah.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a pillar of the prayer, and it praises Allah and asks Him for guidance.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands before, eat with the right hand, eat from in front, do not criticise food, do not waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: "For you is your religion and for me is mine." A Muslim stays firm in his faith and respects the right of others to hold their beliefs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for firmness, 1 mark for respect.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and family connections cannot save a person who refuses the truth and harms good people. We should avoid pride and harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wealth cannot save, 1 mark for harming others is wrong, 1 mark for avoiding pride.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: We should thank Allah and be humble when we succeed, and ask His forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Farming, trading in a kiosk, tailoring, carpentry, teaching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: When a parent commands something Allah forbids. The child should still treat them kindly and politely.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the case, 1 mark for not obeying, 1 mark for kindness.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any ten of Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Ayyub, Shuayb, Musa, Harun, Dhul-Kifl, Dawud, Sulaiman, Ilyas, Al-Yasa, Yunus, Zakariyya, Yahya, Isa, Muhammad.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name up to 5 marks.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Modesty is haya. It means covering properly and dressing decently without showing off.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for haya, 1 mark for covering, 1 mark for not showing off.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ruku, rising from ruku, sujud, sitting between the sujud, last sitting, tashahhud, blessings on the Prophet, taslim.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each two correct pillars up to 4 and 1 mark for correct order.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mukhaffafah (light), mutawassitah (medium) and mughalladha (heavy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: A parent helps with homework and the child says thank you and promises to do well. Award for a clear obligation, a clear action and an expression of thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the obligation, 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for thanks, 2 marks for clarity.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: In later years its people accepted Islam, and many descendants of those who rejected the Prophet became Muslims.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Twahara means purity. It is a condition for prayer and other acts of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for importance.
